about_the_game:
No one has ever returned from Axom alive.

Armed with cutting-edge tech and unbreakable will, you intend to be the first to uncover its secrets…

DEFEND AGAINST THE ENDLESS SWARMS

_____________________________________________________________

Axom: Conquest is a base-building Roguelike set on the hostile planet Axom.

  • Design sprawling fortresses to protect your Nexus Drill against endless swarms of Centurax.

  • Expand your economy by claiming and defending resource nodes scattered across the battlefield.

  • Survive relentless escalation as enemies grow stronger, stranger, and more determined with every wave.

    _________________________________________________________

  • Every Run is Truly Unique – Interlocking systems, procedural maps, branching towers, upgrade chains, corrupted upgrades, and evolving enemy threats combine to make no two runs alike.

  • Wild Synergies – Experiment with hundreds of upgrades, from bouncy walls to nuclear payloads. Stack them, twist them, and unleash chaos.

  • The Alien Infection – Balance offence and defence while holding back the planet itself, as spreading corruption consumes the land, destroys structures, and forces constant adaptation.

  • Build Your Way – Shape the battlefield with towers, walls, and hazards, then pick a Nexus variant before each run, each with unique stats and abilities that steer your strategy beyond pure randomness.

  • Meta Progression – Advance through a vast research tree packed with upgrades, tools, and new options, unlocking lasting advantages that evolve how every run plays out.

  • Streamlined Controls – Fully playable with just a mouse, with keyboard shortcuts available for speed.

INFECTED GROUND

Battle against the planet itself as it comes to destroy you

BUILD YOUR PERFECT DEFENCE

Deploy dozens of towers and hundreds of upgrades

_____________________________________________________________

Story

In the depths of space lies Axom, a planet overflowing with resources, a treasure trove for any daring enough to claim it. But you’re not the first to try.

You are an independent miner with your heart set on riches. 

Standing between you and those untold riches is the Centurax, a relentless alien force guarding their world with unending ferocity. Alone, you’ll face wave after wave, fighting for survival as you strip the planet of its bounty.

Yet as you dig deeper, the true purpose behind the Centurax’s defence begins to emerge, revealing a mystery buried in the planet’s core.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Tower defense with a base-building twist. Construct and expand your fortress with towers, walls, and hazards. Unlock 500+ upgrades, enemies, and structures while balancing offense, defense, and infection to survive the swarm and uncover Axom’s dark secret.
